text:
DiSunno Architecture is seeking an architectural project manager to lead high-end residential and commercial projects across the East End. You’ll work directly with our principals and serve as a day-to-day point of contact for clients, consultants, and contractors. You’ll manage schedules and deliverables, lead drawing production, and coordinate permitting and construction administration.
Candidates should have 5+ years of architectural experience, including responsibility for managing projects and preparing construction documents. Strong Revit skills and proficiency in AutoCAD are required. Familiarity with East End permitting is a plus. Candidates should be licensed or actively pursuing architectural licensure.
Send your résumé and selected work samples, with a brief note about your role on each project, to [email protected]. View our work at disunnoarchitecture.com.
